text: あちゃー　まけた　ところを　みられちゃった

patterns.name: 〜たところ
patterns.explanation: A past verb with ところ means 'the moment of having just done it'. まけた ところを みる = 'see the moment I lost'.

patterns.name: 〜られる (passive)
patterns.explanation: られる on a verb says it was done to you by someone else. みられる = 'be seen'.

patterns.name: 〜てしまう
patterns.explanation: てしまう after a verb says it happened completely, often to your regret; ちゃった is its casual short form. みられちゃった = 'I went and got seen'.
